name: Response (acknowledgement)
fields: u16 original_id; u8 status (0 ACK,1 NAK,2 UNKNOWN_OR_NOT_SUPPORTED,3 COBS_DECODER_ERROR,4 CRC_ERROR,5 LENGTH_ERROR); message-specific payload
evidence: vns.m72690a + gu2 (writer); h6p case 15 (reader, len>=9); enum ly00
in_gadgetbridge: differs (GB sends no reply to unhandled ids; app auto-replies via vid/xid)

name: Download File
fields: u16 file_index; u32 offset; u8 request_type (app sends 1); u16 crc_seed; u32 max_size (0 = whole file); u8 flags
purpose: Start reading a file; reply payload u8 status + u32 file_size

name: Upload File
fields: u16 file_index; u32 size; u32 offset; u16 crc_seed (layout from GB, not yet verified in app)
purpose: Start writing a file to the watch

name: File Data
fields: u8 flags; u16 running_crc; u32 offset; data. Reply payload: u8 status (0 ok,2 abort,3 crc mismatch,4 offset mismatch/resend); u32 bytes_received
purpose: File chunk with running CRC-16/ARC over all bytes so far

name: Create File
fields: unverified in app (GB: u32 size; u8 data_type; u8 sub_type; u16 index; ...)
purpose: Allocate a file on the watch before upload

name: Delete File
purpose: Delete a file on the watch

name: Directory Filter
fields: u8 filter (0 NO_FILTER,1 DEFAULT,3 PENDING_UPLOADS_ONLY); reply payload u8 (0 = supported)

name: Set File Flags
fields: u16 file_index; u8 flags (app sends 0x10 ARCHIVE)
purpose: Mark a file synced (archive) on the watch

name: File Ready
fields: 16-byte directory entry: u16 index; u8 data_type; u8 sub_type; u16 file_number; u8 specific_flags; u8 flags; u32 size; u32 timestamp
in_gadgetbridge: yes (16 bytes at 7257742b; an earlier note here claimed a 17th byte)

name: FIT Definition
purpose: Carry FIT definition messages (capabilities in; connectivity/weather out)

name: Weather Request
fields: unverified in app (GB: u8 format; s32 lat; s32 lon; u8 hours)

name: Battery Status
fields: unverified in app (GB: status bits; voltage; percent)

name: Device Information
fields: watch: u16 protocol_version; u16 product_number; u32 unit_id; u16 software_version; u16 max_packet_size; str bt_name; str device_name; str model_name; [u8 dual_pairing; 6B ble_mac; 6B bt_mac]; [u8 limitation]. Phone reply payload: u16 protocol (113 or 150); u16 0xFFFF; u32 0xFFFFFFFF; u16 app_version; u16 0xFFFF; str friendly_name; str manufacturer; str model; u8 1

name: Set Device Settings
fields: u8 count; count x (u8 id; u8 len; value). Time push uses ids 1..5 (garmin time, dst savings, tz offset, next DST, following DST)
in_gadgetbridge: differs (GB uses it for auto-upload/weather flags)

name: Queued Download
purpose: Watch has queued items; reply payload [0x00]

name: System Event
fields: u8 event (SYNC_COMPLETE 0 .. REQUEST_REBOOT 17, see PROTOCOL.md); u8 value

name: Supported File Types
fields: request: empty. reply payload: u8 count; count x (u8 data_type; u8 sub_type; str name)

name: Sync Request
fields: u8 option (0 MANUAL,1 INVISIBLE,2 VISIBLE_AS_NEEDED); u8 n; n-byte bitmask
purpose: Watch asks the phone to sync

name: Protobuf Request
fields: unverified in app (GB: u16 request_id; u32 offset; u32 total_len; u32 chunk_len; bytes)

name: Configuration
fields: u8 n; n-byte capability bitmask (bit i of byte k = capability 8k+i)

name: Current Time
fields: request: u32 reference_id. reply payload: u32 reference_id; u32 garmin_time; s32 utc_offset_s; u32 next_dst; u32 following_dst

name: Auth Negotiation Begin
purpose: Start of app-level 'Garmin Auth' pairing; only used when the phone is not BLE-bonded
in_gadgetbridge: differs (GB echoes it back with GUESS_OK; the app on a bonded phone treats it as an error and resets)

name: Secure Session
purpose: Garmin Auth; its ACK is sent unencrypted
